name: habblaud
description: Habblaud plugins, the pixel-art virtual office of your Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: habblaud
plugins.description: Habblaud mod: plan usage (5h and weekly) for the office, a notice below the prompt when another session needs you and the /habblaud command.

plugins.name: habblaud-permissoes
plugins.description: Approve or deny Claude Code's permission requests from Habblaud and answer the agent's questions (PermissionRequest hook).

plugins.name: habblaud-mensagens
plugins.description: Send messages from Habblaud: what you type in the office enters the session as if you had typed it in the terminal.
